block_id: Match each terrain polygon block by geometry fields computed from the game's unfixed world verts (raw i32 16.16): nvert, nfaces, sum_x=sum(world_x), sum_z=sum(world_z). Do not key by heap/runtime/reloc block pointers — those change across loads. Look up before applying dx/dz.
description: Per-level XZ translations for terrain polygon blocks. Each entry is {nvert,nfaces,sum_x,sum_z,dx,dz}. Apply (dx,0,dz) to all world verts of the matching block. Residual seam weld is optional (see terrain_seam_pairs.json).
